<Document xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Objectives - 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="At the conclusion of this training, you should be able to:
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="1 - Demonstrate the process of adding a prospect in Applied Epic
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="2 - Execute the validation and updating process for account details in Applied Epic
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="3 - Implement the process of validating and updating Individual and Business contact information in Applied Epic
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style DefaultTabStop="85.33333" LineSpacingRule="SinglePt5" LineSpacing="30" /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Practice Simulation Part 1 - 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="You just watched two short videos demonstrating how to add a prospect and how to validate and update account details.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Now, it's your turn to practice these skills in a simulation environment.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="To start, select "NEXT" and follow the on-screen prompts. If you need assistance, click the "HINT" button.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Good luck!" /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

terms.term: Stands for "doing business as." (or dba, d.b.a., d/b/a) A DBA is any registered name that a business operates under that is not its legal business name.
Standardized coding system used throughout the insurance industry used to group businesses based on their primary activity or type of economic activity.
Any business organization that is legally permitted to enter into a contract.

This refers to the individual who acts as the Main contact for the client and will default to all applicable areas of the account, such as activities and emails, unless manually updated. This should always be an actual person and typically serves as the main point of communication and decision-making for an account
